$description: Replo public signed-out surfaces, measured 2026-11-19 from computed styles in a T3 preview tab. Marketing pages are www.replo.app. The signed-out form is dashboard.replo.app/auth/login, which dashboard.replo.app redirected to via /auth/signup. The product paints one dark theme. Shadcn light tokens declared on :root are not the painted page and are not tokens here. A value that was declared and not painted on a measured control is labelled declared.
